meta.name: CCNL Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione (Confetra)

notes.text: STAFF: tables for non-travelling staff (clerical employees and sedentary workers). The travelling staff (personale viaggiante, drivers and riders: letters C3 to L of pp. 25-26, tables pp. 81-82) is modelled in logistica-trasporto-confetra-viaggiante.

CONGLOBATED MINIMUMS: base_salary values are the conglobated monthly minimum pay (minimum pay table + contingenza per Art. 61 note + EPA). Primary check: Art. 61 of the consolidated text September 2025 — 'From 1.1.2001 the indennità di contingenza has been conglobated into the minimum pay tables together with the EDR of EUR 10.33 per month'. fixed_allowances is empty for all levels.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 168 hours/month. Primary source: Art. 61 para. 3 consolidated text September 2025 — 'The hourly pay is obtained by dividing the monthly pay by 168'.

TRANCHES: four tranches for level 3S: 1.1.2025 +120 (minimo 90 + EPA 30), 1.1.2026 +40 (minimo), 1.1.2027 +30 (EPA), 1.6.2027 +40 (minimo 10 + EPA 30). Source: the tables of pp. 80-81 of the testo unico of 25 September 2025 and the Legacoop circular of 19 December 2024 (p. 2).

ICE: the Indennità di Copertura Economica (ICE) was a provisional element in force until 31.12.2024. It ceases from 1.1.2025 with the renewal taking effect. base_salary values do not include ICE (ceased element). The consolidated text cites net increases of EUR 230 at 3S compared to the previous pay including ICE — the difference from the algebraic sum of the tranches (EUR 290 from base without ICE) corresponds to the pre-existing ICE value for that level.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 (tredicesima Art. 18 + quattordicesima Art. 19 consolidated text September 2025).
SENIORITY INCREMENTS: biennial (24-month cadence), max 5 biennial periods. Amounts from Art. 17 consolidated text September 2025. Non-travelling staff.

LEVEL 6° JUNIOR: not modelled. The profile existed only in 2025 (1,464.53 a month from 1.1.2025, p. 80; seniority step 18.78, art. 17; EDR 2021 7.58, p. 82) and ended on 31.12.2025 (p. 25: 'Il presente profilo avrà termine inderogabilmente il 31 dicembre 2025'), its workers moving to level 6; a level of the bundle must cover the whole span of the ruleset. The request has no override of the level amounts: a 2025 run of a 6J worker on level 6 pays the level 6 minimum (1,615.71) (review of 2026-10-30)

limitation.remediation: Model 6J for 2025 (a level closed on 2025-12-31, or a refusal of 6J runs), or record the limitation for 2025 runs.

notes.text: EPA: Elemento Professionale d'Area, a component introduced by the 6.12.2024 renewal. Included in base_salary values from 1.1.2025. Not shown separately because it forms an integral part of the minimum pay (it affects all contractual and statutory entitlements) — see Confetra circ283-2024.

EDR: the EDR of EUR 10.33/month (agreement 26 Jan 2001) is conglobated into the minimum pay tables (Art. 61 note). The EDR of art. 60 c. 8 (workers in service on 26 January 2011) and the EDR of the agreement of 18 May 2021 (13 mensilità, no effect on other institutes) are paid as allowances; the 2021 EDR may still enter the daily base of absences and sickness, which 'nessuna incidenza su alcun istituto contrattuale' excludes.

limitation.remediation: Exclude EDR_2021 from the daily base of absences and sickness (a relevance flag on the allowance), or source that it enters it.

notes.text: INPS: meta.inps_sectors lists industria (contribution/2026/industria.json) and terziario (contribution/2026/terziario.json); EmployerProfile.inps_sector chooses, and without it the run reads the industria with a missing_fact inps_sector blocker (see the INPS SECTOR OF THE EMPLOYER note) (review of 2026-10-30)

APPRENTICESHIP: percentage type from TABELLA A consolidated text September 2025. 75% year 1 (m1-12), 85% year 2 (m13-24), 100% from m25. Eligible levels: 1, 2, 3, 3S, 4, 4J, 5, 6 (level Q excluded). Maximum duration 36 months. Source: Art. 106 + TABELLA A consolidated text 09/2025 (contrattotrasporti.it).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: SIXTH DAY: Art. 13 c. 6 (p. 39) pays 50% for the overtime of the sixth day of a non-travelling worker whose normal week is spread over five days; the overtime bands have no such kind, so that overtime takes the 30% of the weekday band.

limitation.remediation: Add a sixth-day kind to the overtime event and a 50% band, then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP TABELLA B (testo unico p. 75): the profili artigiani and equivalent profiles (addetti al magazzinaggio, alla manutenzione veicoli, alla movimentazione) are paid 90% in the first year, 95% in the second and 100% after, not the 75 and 85% of Tabella A. The profile, not the level, selects the table: track 'profili_artigiani' beside 'standard'; set Apprentice.track.

PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: supplementary hours are paid with 18% of the hourly quota of the retribuzione globale, 40% past the annual limit (Art. 56, testo unico p. 71). The request has no kind for supplementary hours: an overtime event of a part-time worker takes the overtime bands unless the caller passes the multiplier.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY selects the OT_SUPPLEMENTARE band of the CCNL rate (tests/integration/ccnl_engine/working_time/overtime/test_supplementary.py); the higher rate past the yearly limit is not modelled.

notes.text: HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS: Sanilog (Art. 51, p. 64): 150 euro a year for each worker not in probation with a permanent contract or an apprenticeship, from the employer only, plus the 10% INPS solidarity contribution; Ebilog (Art. 52, p. 65): 3,50 euro a month from the employer and 0,50 euro from the worker, for 12 months, or an EAR of 8 euro a month paid to the worker by an employer outside the bilateral system. Not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Pass the contributions as bilateral fund events, or model them per worker.

notes.text: INPS CONTRIBUTION CLASS: the file applies the rates of the industria (impiegati 29.06% from 16 to 50 employees and 29.36% from 51, operai 31.28% and 31.58% with the 2.22% malattia). The cost table of the Ministry of Labour for this CCNL (DD 135 of 19 December 2025) applies 29.44% to operai and impiegati alike, and states neither the INPS class of the employer nor the composition of the rate: the class of a logistica employer is not confirmed, and the employer and worker contributions may differ.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: the employer states its INPS sector (EmployerProfile.inps_sector, industria or terziario by the CSC of its ATECO in the INPS manual); without it the run has a missing_fact inps_sector blocker. Tested in tests/integration/ccnl_engine/api/test_engine_modes.py.

notes.text: INPS SECTOR OF THE EMPLOYER: INPS classifies an employer by the activity it carries out (art. 49 L. 88/1989), not by the CCNL it applies. The Manuale di classificazione dei datori di lavoro of May 2021 (ATECO 2007, PDF pp. 199-206) gives CSC 11501 (industria, trasporti) to 49.41.00 trasporto di merci su strada and 49.42.00 traslochi, 11505 (industria) to 52.24 movimento merci and 52.21.90, 11506 to 52.21.40 interporti, 11507 to 53.20.00 corrieri, and 70401 (terziario, intermediari) to 52.10.10 magazzini di custodia e deposito, 52.29.10 spedizionieri, 52.29.21 intermediari dei trasporti and 52.29.22 servizi logistici. The employers of this CCNL are therefore in the industria or in the terziario: meta.inps_sectors lists both and EmployerProfile.inps_sector chooses; without it the run reads the industria and has a missing_fact inps_sector blocker. INPS circ. 71/2025 moved the classification to ATECO 2025 from 1 April 2025 and announced a new edition of the manual, not found in this review: the CSC above are those of the 2021 edition.

location.quote: 1% a carico dell'azienda, calcolato sugli elementi della retribuzione mensile composta da minimo tabellare conglobato, EPA, scatti di anzianità, superminimi

provenance.transformation: 1% of the employer and 1% of the worker on the monthly pay of minimo conglobato, EPA, scatti, superminimi, terzo elemento, indennità di mensa and indennità di funzione, for the workers not paying the FASC. The engine computes it on the TFR base, which also holds the extra months: the text names the 'retribuzione mensile' and does not say whether the extra months count, hence derived. The TFR shares (1% of the TFR base for the workers employed by 28 April 1993, the legal share after) follow the enrolment.

location.section: Art. 63 A) c. 7, 8, 12 (Sezione prima)
location.quote: corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione globale mensile per 3 mesi e della metà di essa per altri 5 mesi, se aventi anzianità di servizio non superiore a 5 anni

provenance.transformation: Up to 5 years of seniority: job kept 245 days (c. 7), counted over the 24 months before the day (c. 8), 3 months in full and 5 at half (c. 12): 90 days at 100%, days 91-240 at 50%, then unpaid. Above 5 years: 365 days over 30 months, 5 months in full and 7 at half: 150 days at 100%, days 151-360 at 50%. Months of 30 days; the band from 60 months reads 'superiore ai 5 anni' as five completed years and any further day. The CCNL treatment tops up the INPS indemnity to these shares of the retribuzione globale (c. 13).
provenance.note: Malattie particolarmente gravi (INPS circ. 95/2016): left out of the comporto count (c. 8: 'ad esclusione di quelli per malattie particolarmente gravi') and paid 'con la corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione globale mensile per 18 mesi' (c. 12): 540 days of 30-day months from the first day of the episode, stated by SicknessEpisode.serious_illness.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file (55 records) read again in the signed testo unico of the renewal of 6 December 2024 (Verbale di accordo 25 September 2025), published by Confetra; the URLs the file cited return 404.
findings: Corrected: every one of the 36 salary periods. The base salary is the minimo plus the EPA of the tables of pp. 80-81 for non-travelling staff; the file held values about 88-110 EUR too high. The printed Totale of the 1 January 2027 table already includes the minimo increase of 1 June 2027; the Legacoop circular of 19 December 2024 (p. 2) confirms that January 2027 is an EPA-only step, so the period holds minimo plus EPA.
Corrected: the Quadri receive the indennità di funzione of 51.65 EUR a month (Art. 6 c. 4, p. 17), which the file lacked.
Corrected: the daily quota is 1/22 (Art. 61 c. 3, Sezione prima, p. 86), not 1/26, which applies to a six-day week of non-travelling staff and to Sezione seconda (Art. 73 c. 5).

Verified: 14 monthly payments (Artt. 18-19), the accrual of fractions over 15 days (Art. 18 c. 2, Art. 19 c. 2), seniority (Art. 17) and 22 days of leave (Art. 24). Pages are PDF page numbers, equal to the printed ones.

Assumed: sickness. Art. 63 A) c. 7-12 keeps the job 245 or 365 days and pays 3 months in full and 5 at half (up to 5 years of service) or 5 and 7, counted over 24 or 30 months; the cumulation model holds one window in whole years for every band, so the rule is not expressible and the file's 100% for 180 days is wrong.
Left derived: the overtime rates (30%, 50%, 65%, 75%, Art. 13 c. 6) match, but their start of 2023-05-01 is not stated; the level descriptions are paraphrases.
Not modelled: the EDR of Art. 60 c. 8 (10 EUR at level 3S, re-parametrised) for workers in service on 26 January 2011, which affects every entitlement, and level 6J and travelling staff.

reviews.scope: Sickness rule of art. 63 A), now expressible with a window and steps per seniority band; readiness of the file.
findings: The sickness rule was assumed (100% for 180 days, not the CCNL's): it is now 90 days in full and 150 at half within 24 months, comporto 245 days, up to 5 years of seniority; 150 in full and 210 at half within 30 months, comporto 365 days, above.
With no assumed or missing payable rule left and the salary tables, additional months, divisor and seniority verified on 2026-10-11, the file is promoted to reviewed.
The serious illnesses of INPS circ. 95/2016 were a limitation (grave_illness): now paid in full for 18 months and left out of the comporto when SicknessEpisode.serious_illness says so.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: the salary tables of pp. 80-81 for every tranche, the overtime rates of Art. 13 c. 6 and the remaining derived records.
findings: The minimo plus EPA of every level at 1.1.2025, 1.1.2026, 1.1.2027 and 1.6.2027 match the bundle.
Overtime 30/50/65/75%: verified from 1 January 2025 (the start of the salary series); the unsourced start of 2023-05-01 is dropped.
The 50% of the sixth day of a five-day week is not modelled: declared.
The EDR of 2011 (re-parametrisation by level not stated) and of 2021 (TFR treatment contradictory, pp. 54 and 83) stay derived.

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL I100 matches; the report lists the same associations and FILT, FIT, UILTRASPORTI.
Term: 'Il presente contratto scadrà il 31 dicembre 2027' (testo unico), the same in the report.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'scatti di anzianità, indennità e altri elementi fissi': the scatti and fixed allowances of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: EDR ex accordo 18 maggio 2021 (p. 82, personale non viaggiante): the nine amounts match (Quadri 12,80 to 6° 8,26); 13 mensilità, no effect on other institutes (p. 83). Verified.

EDR of Art. 60 c. 8 (p. 85, 10 euro at 3° Super, staff in service on 26 January 2011): the eight amounts match (Quadro 12,89 to 6° 8,26) and the file gates it with in_service_on 2011-01-26. Verified. The 5-euro table of p. 93 belongs to another article and is not modelled here.
Scatti (Art. 17) were verified in the P1 review; IND_FUN verified.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'part-time, tempo determinato, apprendistato e periodo di prova': the apprenticeship tracks and the part-time supplementary hours of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Tabella A (p. 75) matches the standard track. Tabella B, 90, 95 and 100% for the profili artigiani, was not modelled: added as a track; an apprentice now names it.
Part-time supplementary hours at 18% (40% past the annual limit, Art. 56, p. 71): declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the pension, health and bilateral contributions of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Priamo (Art. 50, pp. 63-64): 1% of the employer and 1% of the worker; no pension fund was modelled: added as an employer fund on the TFR base, derived because the text names the monthly pay.
Sanilog (150 euro a year, employer) and Ebilog (3,50 euro a month employer, 0,50 worker, or an EAR of 8 euro): declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'confrontare lordo, netto e costo azienda con esempi indipendenti': a run of the engine against the cost table of the Ministry of Labour (DD 135 of 19 December 2025, impiegati non viaggianti, January 2026).
findings: Impiegato 3S with 3 scatti, January 2026: minimo plus EPA 2000.37 ((23.644,44 + 360) / 12), scatti 74.37 and EDR 10.00 a month match the table (p. 9); the TFR of the month is the table's TFR base over 13.5 less the 0.5% IVS offset. Match.

Deviation: the table applies an employer INPS rate of 29.44%; the engine applies 29.06% from 16 to 50 employees and 29.36% from 51. Cause not established (the table does not state the class of employer and size); decision: flagged for the INPS review of the logistica contribution class. Sanilog (165 euro) and Ebilog (46,20 euro) of the table equal the declared 150 and 42 euro plus the 10% solidarity contribution. INAIL 0.404%: not computed by the engine. No independent net pay example.

reviews.scope: Closure of the divergence left open by the review 2026-10-15-ai-cost-check: the employer INPS rate against the cost table of the Ministry of Labour (DD 135/2025).
findings: The table prints 'Inps (29,44%)' on every row, operai and impiegati non viaggianti alike (30,68% for the personale viaggiante), with no composition and no class of employer. The 0.08 points above the 29.36% of the engine fit more than one composition (the whole 0.90% CIGS and a 0.24% maternità, for one), and a single rate for operai and impiegati does not fit the industria class of the file, where the operai pay the 2.22% malattia. The class is not established.

divergences.subject: Employer INPS rate of an impiegato non viaggiante, January 2026: 29.44% in DD 135/2025 against 29.06% (16-50 employees) or 29.36% (51 and more) in the engine.
divergences.cause: The table does not state the INPS class of the employer nor the composition of its rate; the class of the file (industria) is not confirmed.
divergences.evidence: DD 135/2025, tables of the personale non viaggiante; the limitation blocks every run of the CCNL.

reviews.scope: Follow-up of the source_context_missing divergence of 2026-10-15-ai-divergences: the composition of the 29.44% of DD 135/2025 for the personale non viaggiante.
findings: The INPS rate tables of January 2023 (reproduced by GIA Parma) have no row of 29.44%: impiegati of class industria pay 29.06% from 16 to 50 employees and 29.36% above. The 30.68% of the personale viaggiante of the same decree is the class industria rate of operai up to 15 employees (review 2026-10-16-ai-inps-composition of logistica-trasporto-confetra-viaggiante).
The composition of 29.44% and the class of the employer remain unknown; the divergence stays open and its limitation keeps blocking the runs.

reviews.scope: The INPS sector of the employers of the CCNL against the INPS classification manual, after the review 2026-10-16-ai-inps-composition left the class of the employer open.
findings: The Manuale di classificazione dei datori di lavoro of INPS (May 2021, ATECO 2007) classifies the activities of this CCNL in two sectors: autotrasporto, traslochi, movimento merci and corrieri in the industria (CSC 11501, 11505, 11507), magazzini di custodia, spedizionieri, intermediari dei trasporti and servizi logistici in the terziario (CSC 70401). The file applied the industria to every employer.

Corrected: meta.inps_sectors lists industria and terziario; EmployerProfile.inps_sector states the sector of the employer and the run reads its INPS rates, sickness cover and every rule that follows the sector; a run without it reads the industria with a missing_fact inps_sector blocker.
INPS circ. 71/2025 adopted ATECO 2025 from 1 April 2025 and announced a new edition of the manual; that edition was not found: the classification above is the one of the 2021 edition.

The 29.44% of DD 135/2025 for the personale non viaggiante is still no INPS rate of either sector: industria impiegati 29.06% (16 to 50 employees) and 29.36% (above 50), terziario 29.31% to 30.11%. The table states neither the class nor the composition; the engine follows the classification of the employer.

divergences.subject: Employer INPS rate of an impiegato non viaggiante, January 2026: 29.44% in DD 135/2025 against 29.06% or 29.36% (industria) and 29.31% to 30.11% (terziario) in the engine.
divergences.cause: The cost table of the Ministry of Labour applies one rate to operai and impiegati and states neither the INPS class of the employer nor the composition of the rate; no composition of the INPS rates of the industria or of the terziario of 2026 gives 29.44%. INPS rates follow the CSC of the employer (art. 49 L. 88/1989), which the employer now states.
divergences.evidence: INPS Manuale di classificazione dei datori di lavoro, May 2021, PDF pp. 199-206; DD 135/2025, tables of the personale non viaggiante.

reviews.scope: The rate of the supplementary hours of the part-time workers.
findings: Art. 56 of the testo unico (p. 71), read in review 2026-10-15-ai-contracts (the Confetra site was down on 2026-10-17): supplementary hours at 18%, 40% past the yearly limit. The 18% band is added for OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY; the 40% needs the yearly count and is not modelled.
